info.title: ParkingBusiness pilot API
info.description: Artifact version only; paths are not version-prefixed. Recorded occupancy is not physical presence. Gate 402/recheck behavior and delayed payment attribution remain deployment assumptions.

bearerAuth.description: One configured credential, scoped to entrance, exit or admin role.

paymentSignature.name: X-Signature
paymentSignature.description: Exactly one lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw request bytes. Unsigned X-Terminal-Compat is not accepted.

post.summary: Check in at an entrance gate

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Exactly one UUID per gate event; reuse for retries.

post.description: Plate: ASCII letters, digits, spaces and hyphens; after removing spaces and hyphens, 1–16 alphanumeric characters. Normalized to uppercase. Authentication precedes JSON validation. Same gate and event ID replays an active success; changed content conflicts.

409.description: REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT, EVENT_CLOSED, RESIDENT_NOT_REGISTERED, ACTIVE_SESSION_EXISTS or CATEGORY_FULL

post.summary: Check out at an exit gate

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Exactly one UUID per gate event; reuse for retries.

post.description: A 200 authorizes exit and releases the recorded space; a 402 is a fixed outstanding quote and does not authorize exit. After 402, the gate rechecks using the same gate, request ID and body until 200; repeated 402s do not themselves start another payment. A later payable interaction with a new request ID replaces the current quote; a retry of the superseded interaction returns 409 CHECKOUT_SUPERSEDED while the session is active. After closure EVENT_CLOSED takes precedence for a non-successful binding. Changed content for a bound ID conflicts before session-state evaluation. A committed 200 replays unchanged for its original gate, ID and body. The first recording of a valid payment starts a 15-minute grace period, inclusive at its start and exclusive at its end; duplicate payment delivery does not extend it. During grace checkout can authorize; after expiry it recalculates the tariff less valid payments or retains an uncovered current quote. Residency in the request does not change entitlement. Gate handling of 402, continued rechecks, supersession and late responses remains unconfirmed by the vendor.
Admin only. Building validation precedes plate validation.

post.description: Available only when a webhook secret is configured. Verify the signature over raw bytes before UTF-8, JSON and payload validation. No content encoding; maximum body 16 KiB. paymentId is nonempty, at most 255 characters and excludes control characters. Successful IDs are deduplicated; FAILED is logged but not persisted. A payment does not release a space.
